No retry, no workaround. Status unverified; prices, sizes, shipping, returns and known_for need a human check (pages/hollister.json human_check).

Wikipedia (fetched 2026-10-29): first store opened 27 July 2000 at Easton Town Center, Columbus, Ohio; the 1922 California founding and 'John Hollister, Sr.' are a fictional backstory created by Abercrombie & Fitch. HQ New Albany, Ohio. Parent Abercrombie & Fitch. Sells apparel, accessories and fragrances; stores styled as beach shacks; 541 locations per the 2022 annual report.

Parent's site (corporate.abercrombie.com, fetched 2026-10-29) lists Hollister among Abercrombie & Fitch Co. brands with Abercrombie & Fitch and abercrombie kids (page title also names Gilly Hicks and Social Tourist). Hollister tagline there: 'Clothes made for capturing moments, creating memories and being unapologetically you.'
Ahrefs SERP title for https://www.hollisterco.com/shop/us (2026-10-29): 'Clothing for Women & Men | Teen Clothing | Hollister Co.' Not fetched by us (bot wall), so known_for is left empty.
